comments.note: The ProjectCommentSchema.agent field (z.string()) is intentionally free-text and not constrained to AGENT_ROLES. This is the correct design — project_comments are narrative/audit records and the agent field there is a human-readable identifier, not a workflow role. The exemption in this WP is architecturally sound. Worth documenting this distinction in constraints.md to prevent future confusion: assigned_to requires a canonical AgentRole, but project_comments.agent does not.

AC1 wording ('4 out-of-scope strings') was flagged independently by both Developer and QA as slightly imprecise — 3 of those strings use lowercase 'agent' and are invisible to a case-sensitive grep. The functional outcome is correct (zero invalid schema values remain), but future WP authors should avoid enumerating exempt strings that differ only in casing from the verification target. Recommend adding a note to PM persona: only enumerate out-of-scope items that would produce false positives in the stated verification command.
